Name: Sprinkler Preview (EQ)
Author: eqlyze
Description:
Sprinkler Preview helps you plan your farm better by visualizing exactly which tiles your sprinklers cover, both before placing them [i]and[/i] for sprinklers you’ve already installed (toggled with [b]F6[/b]).

[b][u]Features[/u]:[/b]
[list]
[*]Live preview while holding a sprinkler: shows a transparent blue grid (only when the tile is valid for placement).
[*]Toggleable overlay for placed sprinklers (Press [b]F6[/b] to enable/disable).
[*]Pressure Nozzle support: if a placed sprinkler has the nozzle attachment, the extra tiles get a transparent [b]light purple[/b] outline so you can visualize the boosted coverage.
[/list][u]Installation[/u][list=1]
[*]Download the latest .zip file from this page.
[*]Unzip into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI.
[/list][u]Configuration / Controls[/u][list]
[*][i]Require Hold Key[/i] (config option): if true, you must hold your chosen key (default: [b]Left Shift[/b]) to see the held-sprinkler preview.
[*][i]Toggle Placed Previews Key[/i]: Press [b]F6[/b] to toggle on/off the overlay for placed sprinklers.
[*][i]Show Placed Previews[/i]: whether the placed overlay starts on or off (default: off).
[/list][u]Changelog[/u][list]
[*][b]v0.1.0[/b] — First Release. Adds Pressure Nozzle support with purple ring, improves placed sprinkler overlay toggle.
[*][b]v0.0.0[/b] — Initial prototype (unreleased): blue preview for held sprinklers + placed sprinklers overlay (no nozzle support).
[/list][u]Dependencies[/u][list]
[*]Stardew Valley
[*]SMAPI Mod Loader
[/list][u]Permissions & Credits[/u][list]
[*]You may use, share, and mod this mod [b]non-commercially[/b].
[*]If including in packs, please credit “Sprinkler Preview by eqlyze”.
[*]No assets from other authors are used (vanilla sprites + SMAPI APIs).
[/list]
